_what: Ten-Percent Days 3.0 v4d FORWARD TEST (nightly refit challenger), pre-registered 2026-09-16 before the first v4d snapshot. User 2026-09-16: 'for every prediction each day please train the model to improve it'. v4 keeps its locked monthly refit and remains the model of record; v4d runs alongside in its own snapshot root and replaces v4 on any surface only if the comparison below says PROMOTE.
model: v4d: identical to v4 (MODEL_COLUMNS_V4, HEADS_V4, GBM_PARAMS, 18-month cap, same evening results capture and feature store) except the fold: refit every night on every label whose horizon ended before the target session D, i.e. through the close of T (forward_v4.daily_fold). v4 refits once per month on labels that ended before the month's first session.

snapshot_rules.score_after: 20:30 IST on T and after the v4 snapshot for the same D is frozen
snapshot_rules.requires: the same evening results capture file v4 used, hashed into the manifest

history_informing_this_lock.result: no detectable difference on any head. AUC higher for daily on all four heads (+0.003 to +0.020). Top-10 paired hits per session: +5% -0.055 [-0.24, +0.15], -5% +0.127 [-0.04, +0.30], +10% +0.091 [-0.04, +0.22], -10% +0.036 [-0.04, +0.12]. +5% calls at >= 0.30 realised 26.8% for daily against 31.5% for monthly (mean predicted 0.382 and 0.381).

comparison_with_v4.rows: graded rows of both snapshot roots; only target sessions graded in BOTH count

outcomes.PROMOTE: 95% CI lower bound of (v4d top-10 hits - v4 top-10 hits) per session >= -0.25, AND pooled AUC(v4d) >= AUC(v4) - 0.005, AND (when both have >= 100 rows at p >= 0.30) |mean p - realised| for v4d <= v4's + 0.03. The fresher model is preferred when it is not worse.
outcomes.KEEP_V4: the CI upper bound < 0, OR AUC(v4d) < AUC(v4) - 0.005, OR the high-band calibration guard fails.
outcomes.INCONCLUSIVE: fewer than 120 paired sessions, or the CI spans the margin: v4 stays the model of record and both keep running.

high_confidence.calibrated_if: mean predicted probability of rows >= threshold inside the Wilson 95% interval of their realised rate
high_confidence.may_be_shown_as_high_confidence_only_if: the head's high-confidence rule PASSES at the verdict; before that, >= 50% rows are logged, never labelled as confident
high_confidence.if_fewer_than_min_rows_at_verdict: INSUFFICIENT: no high-confidence label for that head
high_confidence.note: same rule and values as thresholds_lock_v4_forward.json, judged on v4d's own rows

serving: nothing served from v4d unless the comparison says PROMOTE and the v4 serving conditions are also met; the page shows v4
